series.name: SUN-5/6/8/10/12/15/20/25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 (three-phase 384V high-voltage hybrid, dual battery)
series.notes: Chart 7-1 of the SUN-5-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 user manual, chapter 7 'Fault information and processing'. 28 fault rows, all Fxx, no warning table. Chart 4-1 LED table again gives Alarm = red led solid light. This is Deye's high-voltage three-phase line (384V DC bus, battery 1 and battery 2 terminals) and it is the line with the most divergent F-number meanings. CRITICAL CONFLICT: F42 here is Parallel_Version_Fault while on SG03LP1 and SG04LP3 F42 is AC line low voltage; F55 is BAT1_VoltHigh_Fault here but DC busbar voltage too high on SG04LP3; F56 is BAT1_VoltLow_Fault here but DC busbar voltage too low on both LP lines. F52/F53 and F54/F57 (dual battery) exist only here. Never merge this table with Series 1 or 2.

title.ur: DC input ki polarity ulat hui hai

meaning.en: PV DC input polarity is reversed, so the inverter will not accept the array and stays stopped.
meaning.ur: PV DC input ki polarity ulat hui hai, is liye inverter array nahi leta aur band rehta hai.

causes.en: PV string connected backwards at the DC input connector.
causes.ur: PV string DC input connector par ulat kar lagi gayi.

causes.en: A string was moved to a different MPPT input during extension work.
causes.ur: Extension ke kaam ke dauran koi string doosre MPPT input par shift kar di gayi.

solutions.en: Open the DC switch and confirm DC is dead with a voltage tester before touching connectors.
solutions.ur: DC switch khol ke connector chhune se pehle voltage tester se DC dead hai confirm karein.

solutions.en: Probe the string positive and negative at the DC input on DC volts and read the sign.
solutions.ur: DC volt par string ka positive aur negative DC input par probe karke sign dekhein.

solutions.en: Re-connect with correct polarity, then close the DC switch and restart.
solutions.ur: Sahi polarity se dobara jodein, phir DC switch band karke restart karein.

solutions.en: If polarity is right and F01 remains, the polarity detection circuit needs board-level repair.
solutions.ur: Agar polarity theek hai phir bhi F01 rahe to polarity detection circuit ka board level repair chahiye.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.ur: DC_START_Failure (DC bus nahi banta)

meaning.en: The DC bus voltage could not be built from PV or battery, so the inverter will not start.
meaning.ur: PV ya battery se DC bus voltage nahi bana, is liye inverter start nahi hota.

causes.en: Both battery strings are disconnected, deeply discharged or their fuses are open.
causes.ur: Dono battery strings disconnect hain, gehri tarah discharged hain ya unke fuse khule hain.

causes.en: PV voltage is below the minimum start voltage or a string fuse has blown.
causes.ur: PV voltage minimum start voltage se kam hai ya kisi string ka fuse udd chuka hai.

causes.en: Busbar voltage sensing or the boost/auxiliary supply has failed.
causes.ur: Busbar voltage sensing ya boost ya auxiliary supply fail ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Measure battery 1 and battery 2 terminal voltages with a multimeter and compare with the manual DC window.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se battery 1 aur battery 2 ke terminal voltages naalein aur manual ke DC range se compare karein.

solutions.en: With DC switch off, check both string fuses and both battery connectors for a firm, correct-pole landing.
solutions.ur: DC switch off karke dono string fuses aur dono battery connectors ki mazboot aur sahi polarity landing check karein.

solutions.en: Measure PV string Voc and confirm it clears the minimum start voltage in the spec.
solutions.ur: PV string ki Voc naalein aur confirm karein ke ye spec ka minimum start voltage cross karti hai.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter; if the fault still exists contact Deye support.
solutions.ur: Inverter restart karein; fault phir bhi rahe to Deye support se rabta karein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.ur: Working mode change ki indication

meaning.en: Not a real fault — Deye reports F13 after a grid type or frequency change, a battery mode change to No battery, or a work-mode change on old firmware.
meaning.ur: Ye asli fault nahi — grid type ya frequency change, battery mode ko No battery karna, ya purane firmware par work mode change ke baad Deye F13 report karta hai.

causes.en: Grid type and frequency settings were changed.
causes.ur: Grid type aur frequency ki setting badli gayi.

causes.en: Battery mode was changed to No battery mode.
causes.ur: Battery mode No battery mode par kiya gaya.

causes.en: Old firmware reports F13 on any system work mode change.
causes.ur: Purana firmware har system work mode change par F13 report karta hai.

solutions.en: Wait a minute — the manual says F13 generally disappears automatically.
solutions.ur: Ek minute intezaar karein, manual ke mutabiq F13 khud ba khud clear ho jata hai.

solutions.en: Still present: turn on DC and AC switch for one minute, then turn them back on.
solutions.ur: Phir bhi mojood ho to DC aur AC switch ek minute ke liye on karke phir wapas band karein, uske baad on karein.

solutions.en: Record which settings you changed before the code appeared for Deye support.
solutions.ur: Code aane se pehle kaun si settings badli thi woh likh lein Deye support ke liye.

solutions.en: Code on every boot with no change: contact Deye service.
solutions.ur: Koi badlav nahi hone par bhi har boot par code aaye to Deye service se rabta karein.

notes.en: This manual's F13 step 5 wording is a translation error (turn on then turn on again) — the intent, same as the LP manuals, is a one-minute power cycle.
notes.ur: Is manual ke F13 step 5 ka alfaaz tarjuma ghalti hai (on karke phir on karna) — maqsad LP manuals ki tarah ek minute ka power cycle hai.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.en: AC over current fault of software
title.ur: Software wala AC over current fault

meaning.en: Inverter software detected over current on the AC side at the backup and common load output.
meaning.ur: Inverter software ne backup aur common load output ke AC side par over current detect kiya.

causes.en: Backup load plus common load power above the inverter rating.
causes.ur: Backup load aur common load ki power inverter rating se upar.

causes.en: Inrush from a large motor, chiller or compressor on the AC output.
causes.ur: AC output par bare motor, chiller ya compressor ka inrush.

causes.en: Three-phase load heavily unbalanced so one phase current is too high.
causes.ur: Teen phase ka load bahut unbalanced hai jis se aik phase ka current bohat zyada hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the backup load and common load power are within the range, in writing.
solutions.ur: Likh kar check karein ke backup load aur common load ki power range ke andar hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Remove the heaviest load, restart, and check whether the unit returns to normal.
solutions.ur: Sabse bhaari load hata dein, restart karke dekhein ke unit normal par wapas aata hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Clamp-meter all three phases and rebalance so no phase is carrying the total alone.
solutions.ur: Teenon phases ka clamp meter se current naalein aur balance karein taake koi phase poora load na sambhale.

solutions.en: F15 on a small balanced load means the current sensing channel or firmware is at fault — Deye service.
solutions.ur: Halke balanced load par bhi F15 ka matlab hai ke current sensing channel ya firmware kharab hai, Deye service chahiye.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.ur: AC leakage current fault, GFCI trigger hua

meaning.en: The GFCI leakage detector has tripped on the AC side, so the inverter drops the AC output.
meaning.ur: AC side par GFCI leakage detector trigger ho gaya hai, is liye inverter AC output girata hai.

causes.en: PV side cable ground connection is not correct.
causes.ur: PV side cable ka ground connection sahi nahi hai.

causes.en: An appliance on the backup or common load is leaking to earth.
causes.ur: Backup ya common load par koi appliance earth mein leak kar rahi hai.

causes.en: Water or dust in an outdoor junction box or socket.
causes.ur: Outdoor junction box ya socket mein paani ya dhool.

causes.en: Leakage current sensor or detection circuit has drifted.
causes.ur: Leakage current sensor ya detection circuit drift kar gaya hai.

solutions.en: Check the PV side cable ground connection first, then correct any loose earth termination.
solutions.ur: Pehle PV side cable ka ground connection check karein, phir koi bhi loose earth termination theek karein.

solutions.en: Isolate loads on the backup and common load one at a time, re-energising after each, to find the leaker.
solutions.ur: Backup aur common load ke loads ek ek karke isolate karein, har baar dobara power de kar, leak karne wala dhoondhein.

solutions.en: Clamp-meter the earth/neutral conductor and watch the leakage reading in mA.
solutions.ur: Earth ya neutral conductor par clamp meter lagayein aur leakage reading mA mein dekhein.

solutions.en: Restart the system two or three times as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq system do ya teen baar restart karein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.en: AC over current fault of the hardware
title.ur: Hardware wala AC over current fault

meaning.en: The hardware measured AC side over current (F15 is the software detection of the same family). Output is cut until it clears.
meaning.ur: Hardware ne AC side par over current measure kiya hai, isi family ka software detection F15 hai. Fault clear hone tak output band rehta hai.

causes.en: Backup plus common load power is above the allowed range.
causes.ur: Backup aur common load ki power ijazat shuda range se upar hai.

causes.en: Current sensor or its harness on the power board is faulty.
causes.ur: Power board ka current sensor ya uski harness kharab hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the backup load and common load power are within the range.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke backup load aur common load ki power range ke andar hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Restart and check whether the unit returns to normal.
solutions.ur: Restart karke dekhein ke unit normal par wapas aata hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: F18 on a light load points to the AC current sensor or power board — board-level replacement.
solutions.ur: Halkay load par F18 ka matlab hai ke AC current sensor ya power board kharab hai, board level replacement hoga.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.en: DC over current fault of the hardware
title.ur: Hardware wala DC over current fault

meaning.en: Over current on the DC side from PV or battery. Off-grid startup with a large load can also trigger it.
meaning.ur: PV ya battery se DC side par over current. Off-grid startup par bare load bhi isko trigger kar sakta hai.

causes.en: PV module or battery connection loose, shorted or on the wrong cable.
causes.ur: PV module ya battery ka connection loose, short ya galat cable par hai.

causes.en: Inverter started with a very large off-grid load causing DC inrush.
causes.ur: Inverter bohat bare off-grid load ke saath start hua jis se DC inrush hua.

causes.en: DC current sensor or its detection circuit has failed.
causes.ur: DC current sensor ya uska detection circuit fail ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: Check the PV module connection and the battery connection, with power off at the DC switch.
solutions.ur: DC switch off karke PV module connection aur battery connection check karein.

solutions.en: If it tripped on off-grid startup, reduce the load power connected before retrying.
solutions.ur: Agar off-grid startup par trigger hua tha to retry se pehle jura hua load power kam kar dein.

solutions.en: Power-cycle DC and AC for one minute, then re-read the code.
solutions.ur: DC aur AC ko ek minute ke liye cycle karke code dobara dekhein.

solutions.en: Repetitive with good wiring: DC current sensor or its board needs service.
solutions.ur: Achi wiring ke saath baar baar aaye to DC current sensor ya uska board service maangta hai.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.ur: BUS over current (high voltage bus)

meaning.en: The high-voltage DC bus has drawn over current. Deye's first instruction is to check the PV input and battery current settings.
meaning.ur: High voltage DC bus ne over current liya hai. Deye ka pehla instruction hai ke PV input aur battery current ki setting check karein.

causes.en: PV input current or battery current setting does not match the array or pack.
causes.ur: PV input current ya battery current ki setting array ya pack se match nahi karti.

causes.en: Actual current is above the configured limit.
causes.ur: Asli current configured limit se upar hai.

causes.en: Busbar sensing drift causing the control loop to over-drive the bus.
causes.ur: Busbar sensing drift jis se control loop bus ko over drive karta hai.

solutions.en: With the inverter off, measure real PV and battery current with a clamp meter.
solutions.ur: Inverter off karke clamp meter se asal PV aur battery current naalein.

solutions.en: Correct the PV input current and battery current values in the settings to the real array.
solutions.ur: Settings mein PV input current aur battery current ki values asal array ke mutabiq theek karein.

solutions.en: Restart two or three times and watch the bus voltage on the LCD.
solutions.ur: Do ya teen baar restart karke LCD par bus voltage dekhein.

solutions.en: Fault with correct settings: verify the firmware matches the hardware, then contact Deye.
solutions.ur: Settings theek hone par bhi fault ho to firmware aur hardware ka match check karke Deye se rabta karein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.ur: Emergency stop ya remote shutdown

meaning.en: The inverter was remotely shut down. The manual simply says it tells the inverter is remotely controlled.
meaning.ur: Inverter ko remotely band kiya gaya hai. Manual sirf itna kehta hai ke ye batata hai ke inverter remote control ho raha hai.

causes.en: A stop command from the Deye app, cloud or datalogger.
causes.ur: Deye app, cloud ya datalogger se stop command aaya.

causes.en: Generator or smart-switch dry contact asserted by site wiring.
causes.ur: Generator ya smart switch ka dry contact site wiring se assert ho gaya.

solutions.en: Check the Deye app and logger for a stored stop command and cancel it.
solutions.ur: Deye app aur logger mein mojood stop command check karke use cancel kar dein.

solutions.en: With power off, check the generator and smart-switch dry contact wiring for a short to COM.
solutions.ur: Power off karke generator aur smart switch ke dry contact wiring mein COM par short check karein.

solutions.en: Power-cycle and confirm; contact the installer if the stop reappears with no command issued.
solutions.ur: Power cycle karke confirm karein; koi command na hone ke bawajood dobara stop ho to installer se rabta karein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.ur: Leakage current ka transient over current

meaning.en: A transient leakage current was detected on the PV side. Restarting two or three times usually clears it.
meaning.ur: PV side par ek transient leakage current detect hua. Do ya teen baar restart karne se aam tor par clear ho jata hai.

causes.en: PV side cable ground connection is not correct.
causes.ur: PV side cable ka ground connection theek nahi hai.

causes.en: Moisture in a DC connector or junction box after rain, dust or fog.
causes.ur: Baarish, dhool ya dhund ke baad DC connector ya junction box mein nama.

causes.en: Broken cable insulation touching frame or PE.
causes.ur: Tooti cable insulation frame ya PE ko chhu rahi hai.

solutions.en: Check the PV side cable ground connection and re-make the earth termination.
solutions.ur: PV side cable ka ground connection check karke earth termination dobara banayein.

solutions.en: Restart the system two or three times as the manual directs.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq system do se teen baar restart karein.

solutions.en: If it keeps coming back, insulation-test the strings with the inverter disconnected and replace wet connectors.
solutions.ur: Baar baar aaye to inverter disconnect karke strings ka insulation test karein aur geele connectors replace karein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.ur: DC insulation failure (PV se earth)

meaning.en: PV isolation resistance is too low, so the inverter removes the PV input for safety.
meaning.ur: PV isolation resistance bohat kam hai, is liye inverter suraksha ke liye PV input disconnect kar deta hai.

causes.en: PV panels and inverter are not firmly and correctly connected.
causes.ur: PV panels aur inverter ka connection mazboot aur sahi nahi hai.

causes.en: The PE cable of the inverter is not connected to ground.
causes.ur: Inverter ki PE cable ground se juri nahi hui.

causes.en: String shorted to the aluminium frame or a grounded rail.
causes.ur: String aluminium frame ya grounded rail par short ho gayi.

solutions.en: Open the DC switch, verify the PV input is dead, then check the panel and inverter connections firmly.
solutions.ur: DC switch khol ke PV input dead hai verify karein, phir panel aur inverter ke connections ki mazbooti check karein.

solutions.en: Verify the inverter PE cable is connected to ground on a clean, tight earth bar.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke inverter ki PE cable saaf aur mazboot earth bar par ground se juri hui hai.

solutions.en: With strings disconnected, insulation-test one string at a time and replace the failing cable or connector.
solutions.ur: Strings disconnect karke ek ek karke insulation test karein aur fail hone wali cable ya connector replace karein.

solutions.en: All strings test clean: check the inverter's internal insulation monitoring circuit, then contact Deye.
solutions.ur: Sab strings saaf niklein to inverter ka internal insulation monitoring circuit check karke Deye se rabta karein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.ur: DC busbar unbalanced hai

meaning.en: The DC busbar halves are out of balance. Triggers listed by Deye: very different three-phase load, and DC leakage current.
meaning.ur: DC busbar ke do hisse balance mein nahi hain. Deye ke mutabiq triggers: teen phase ka load bohat different hona aur DC leakage current.

causes.en: Load power of the three phases is very different.
causes.ur: Teen phases ka load power bahut different hai.

causes.en: DC leakage current is present.
causes.ur: DC leakage current mojood hai.

causes.en: Busbar balancing control or sensing has drifted.
causes.ur: Busbar balancing control ya sensing drift kar gaya hai.

solutions.en: Wait a while and check whether the code clears on its own.
solutions.ur: Kuch der intezaar karein aur dekhein ke code khud clear hota hai ya nahi.

solutions.en: Rebalance the three phases by shifting load off the heaviest phase.
solutions.ur: Sabse bhaari phase se load hata kar teen phases ko balance karein.

solutions.en: Look for DC leakage current, which the manual lists as a separate F26 cause.
solutions.ur: DC leakage current dekhein, manual usay F26 ki alag wajah batata hai.

solutions.en: Restart two or three times; if it persists on balanced loads, request service.
solutions.ur: Do se teen baar restart karein; balanced load par bhi rahe to service mangwayein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.ur: Parallel units ka communication fail

meaning.en: Communication between paralleled inverters has failed, or the communication address setting is wrong.
meaning.ur: Parallel inverters ke darmiyan communication fail ho gaya hai ya communication address ki setting ghalti hai.

causes.en: Parallel communication cable connection is loose or on the wrong pins.
causes.ur: Parallel communication cable ka connection loose hai ya galat pins par hai.

causes.en: Communication address setting is duplicated across the parallel units.
causes.ur: Parallel units mein communication address ki setting duplicate hai.

causes.en: One unit is still booting so the bus is incomplete.
causes.ur: Koi aik unit abhi boot ho raha hai, is liye bus mukammal nahi hua.

solutions.en: In parallel mode check the parallel communication cable connection on every unit.
solutions.ur: Parallel mode mein har unit par parallel communication cable ka connection check karein.

solutions.en: Verify each unit's communication address is unique and correctly numbered.
solutions.ur: Har unit ka communication address unique aur sahi number par check karein.

solutions.en: Expect F29 on all units during parallel startup; only judge after every unit is ON.
solutions.ur: Parallel startup ke dauran sab units par F29 normal hai; sirf sab units ON hone ke baad faisla karein.

solutions.en: If it still exists, reseat all comms connectors with power off and re-check addressing.
solutions.ur: Phir bhi rahe to power off karke sab comms connectors dobara baithayein aur addressing dobara check karein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.ur: Backup load par AC overload fault

meaning.en: The backup load connection is outside the allowed power range, so the inverter overloads out.
meaning.ur: Backup load connection ijazat shuda power range se bahar hai, is liye inverter overload ho ke band ho jata hai.

causes.en: Backup load power exceeds the allowed range for this model.
causes.ur: Backup load ki power is model ki ijazat shuda range se upar hai.

causes.en: Motor or compressor inrush on the backup output.
causes.ur: Backup output par motor ya compressor ka inrush.

causes.en: Load not divided properly across parallel units.
causes.ur: Parallel units mein load sahi tarah baanta nahi gaya.

solutions.en: Check the backup load connection and confirm it is inside the allowed power range.
solutions.ur: Backup load connection check karke confirm karein ke ye ijazat shuda power range ke andar hai.

solutions.en: Remove the largest load, restart, and clamp-meter the backup output current.
solutions.ur: Sabse bhaari load hata dein, restart karke backup output ka current clamp meter se naalein.

solutions.en: On parallel sets confirm the load is shared so each unit stays under its own rating.
solutions.ur: Parallel set par confirm karein ke load share ho raha hai taake har unit apni rating ke andar rahe.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.en: Parallel system stop (one unit shut down)
title.ur: Parallel system stop (aik unit band)

meaning.en: One hybrid inverter in the parallel set is shut down, so all units report F41 and stop.
meaning.ur: Parallel set mein aik hybrid inverter band ho gaya, is liye sab units F41 report kar ke ruk jate hain.

causes.en: One parallel unit has shut down on an internal fault.
causes.ur: Koi aik parallel unit kisi internal fault par band ho gaya.

causes.en: One unit's DC switch is off or its supply is missing.
causes.ur: Kisi aik unit ka DC switch band hai ya usay supply nahi mil raha.

causes.en: Address setting duplicated across the set.
causes.ur: Set ke andar address ki setting duplicate hai.

solutions.en: Check the hybrid inverter working status on each unit and find the OFF one.
solutions.ur: Har unit par hybrid inverter ki working status check karke OFF wala unit dhoondhein.

solutions.en: Clear that unit's own fault code, then bring it to ON.
solutions.ur: Us unit ka apna fault code clear karke usay ON par laayein.

solutions.en: All units ON and F41 still shown: power off, reseat CAN and comms cabling, then restart from the master.
solutions.ur: Sab units ON hone par bhi F41 ho to power off karke CAN aur comms wiring dobara baithayein, phir master se restart karein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.ur: Parallel version fault, firmware mismatch

meaning.en: In parallel operation the units do not run the same firmware version, so Deye blocks the parallel set. NOTE: on SG03LP1 and SG04LP3 this same number means AC line low voltage.
meaning.ur: Parallel operation mein units ka firmware version aik jaisa nahi hai, is liye Deye parallel set block kar deta hai. NOTE: SG03LP1 aur SG04LP3 par yehi number AC line low voltage ka matlab rakhta hai.

causes.en: The parallel units are running different firmware versions.
causes.ur: Parallel units alag alag firmware version par chal rahe hain.

causes.en: One unit was updated and the others were not.
causes.ur: Kisi aik unit update hua jab ke baqi nahi hue.

causes.en: A unit was replaced with a different model or revision.
causes.ur: Kisi aik unit ki jagah alag model ya revision ka unit lag gaya.

solutions.en: Check whether the inverter version is consistent — that is the manual's step 1.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke inverter version consistent hai ya nahi, yehi manual ka step 1 hai.

solutions.en: Read the firmware version on each unit's LCD and device info page and list them side by side.
solutions.ur: Har unit ke LCD aur device info page se firmware version parhein aur saath saath likhein.

solutions.en: Contact Deye to upgrade the software version so all units match — do not update one unit alone.
solutions.ur: Deye se rabta karke software version upgrade karwayein taake sab units match hon — sirf aik unit update na karein.

solutions.en: Until versions match, take the mismatched unit out of the parallel set and run it standalone.
solutions.ur: Jab tak version match na ho, mismatched unit ko parallel set se nikal kar akela chalaayein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.ur: Grid frequency zyada hai, fault ke saath

meaning.en: Grid frequency is outside the specification range, so the inverter stops feeding the grid.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency specification range se bahar hai, is liye inverter grid ko power dena band kar deta hai.

causes.en: Actual grid frequency is high or unstable.
causes.ur: Asli grid frequency high ya unstable hai.

causes.en: Grid type set to 50 Hz while the real supply is 60 Hz.
causes.ur: Grid type 50 Hz par set hai jab ke asal supply 60 Hz hai.

causes.en: Genset governor hunting, or AC cables loose.
causes.ur: Genset ka governor oscillate kar raha hai, ya AC cables loose hain.

solutions.en: Check the frequency is in the specification range using a clamp meter on frequency mode.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter ko frequency mode par set karke check karein ke frequency specification range mein hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the grid AC cables are firmly and correctly connected; re-tighten every terminal.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke grid AC cables mazboot aur sahi tarah se connected hain; har terminal dobara tighten karein.

solutions.en: Check the grid type / frequency setting against the real supply and stabilise a genset if one is used.
solutions.ur: Grid type aur frequency setting ko asal supply se check karein aur genset ho to usay stable karein.

solutions.en: Restart once frequency is back inside the window.
solutions.ur: Frequency range mein aane ke baad restart karein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.ur: Grid frequency kam hai, fault ke saath

meaning.en: Grid frequency is below the specification range, so the inverter stops.
meaning.ur: Grid frequency specification range se neeche hai, is liye inverter band ho jata hai.

causes.en: Weak or overloaded grid dragging frequency down.
causes.ur: Kamzor ya zyada load wala grid frequency neeche gira raha hai.

causes.en: Grid type set to 50 Hz while the real supply is 60 Hz.
causes.ur: Grid type 50 Hz par set hai jab ke asal supply 60 Hz hai.

causes.en: Genset running too slow, or AC cables loose.
causes.ur: Genset bohat dheere chal raha hai, ya AC cables loose hain.

solutions.en: Check the frequency is in the specification range with a clamp meter on frequency mode.
solutions.ur: Clamp meter ko frequency mode par set karke check karein ke frequency specification range mein hai.

solutions.en: Confirm the grid AC cables are firmly and correctly connected; re-tighten every terminal.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke grid AC cables mazboot aur sahi tarah se connected hain; har terminal dobara tighten karein.

solutions.en: Adjust a genset's speed so frequency returns to the window and let it settle before restart.
solutions.ur: Genset ki speed theek karein taake frequency range mein aaye aur restart se pehle settle hone dein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.ur: DC bus voltage bohat zyada hai

meaning.en: The DC busbar voltage is above the limit. Deye asks you to check the battery voltage and the PV input voltage range.
meaning.ur: DC busbar voltage limit se upar hai. Deye kehta hai ke battery voltage aur PV input voltage ka range check karein.

causes.en: Battery voltage above the allowed window for the pack.
causes.ur: Battery voltage pack ki ijazat shuda window se upar hai.

causes.en: PV input voltage above the maximum DC input, e.g. too many modules in series for cold conditions.
causes.ur: PV input voltage maximum DC input se upar hai, jaise thand mein series mein modules zyada ho.

causes.en: Float or charge voltage setting higher than the battery can safely hold.
causes.ur: Float ya charge voltage ki setting battery se zyada hai jo battery safely hold kar sakta hai.

solutions.en: With AC and DC off, measure battery 1 and battery 2 terminal voltages and compare with the manual DC window.
solutions.ur: AC aur DC off karke battery 1 aur battery 2 ke terminal voltages naalein aur manual ke DC range se compare karein.

solutions.en: Measure the PV string Voc and confirm it is inside the allowed PV input range, including on a cold morning.
solutions.ur: PV string ki Voc naalein aur confirm karein ke ye ijazat shuda PV input range mein hai, thand ki subah bhi.

solutions.en: Reduce the number of PV modules in series if cold-morning Voc exceeds the limit.
solutions.ur: Agar thand ki subah Voc limit cross kare to series mein modules ki tadaad kam karein.

solutions.en: If both measurements are inside the window, the busbar voltage detection circuit needs service.
solutions.ur: Dono measurements range ke andar hon to busbar voltage detection circuit ko service chahiye.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.ur: DC bus voltage bohat kam hai

meaning.en: The DC busbar voltage is below the limit. Deye asks you to check the battery voltage and charge from PV or grid.
meaning.ur: DC busbar voltage limit se neeche hai. Deye kehta hai ke battery voltage check karein aur PV ya grid se charge karein.

causes.en: Battery voltage too low, normally deep discharge or an idle bank.
causes.ur: Battery voltage bohat kam, aam tor par gehri discharge ya khali bank.

causes.en: PV input voltage too low to charge, e.g. early morning or shaded array.
causes.ur: PV input voltage charge karne ke liye bohat kam, jaise subah jaldi ya parda.

causes.en: Battery fuse, connector or BMS contact open.
causes.ur: Battery fuse, connector ya BMS ka contact khula hua hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the battery voltage is too low, measuring both battery strings on a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke battery voltage bohat kam to nahi, dono battery strings ko multimeter se naalein.

solutions.en: If the battery voltage is too low, charge it with PV or grid as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Battery voltage kam ho to manual ke mutabiq use PV ya grid se charge karein.

solutions.en: With DC off, check both string fuses, both connectors and the BMS contact for a solid connection.
solutions.ur: DC off karke dono string fuses, dono connectors aur BMS contact ki mazboot connection check karein.

solutions.en: Charged but bus stays low: the busbar voltage sampling wiring is faulty.
solutions.ur: Charge ho jaye phir bhi bus kam rahe to busbar voltage sampling wiring kharab hai.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.ur: Battery 2 ka terminal voltage zyada hai

meaning.en: The battery 2 string terminal voltage is high. Deye asks for two restarts and a factory reset before calling for help.
meaning.ur: Battery 2 string ka terminal voltage zyada hai. Deye madad se pehle do restart aur factory reset kahein karta hai.

causes.en: Battery 2 string overcharged, or its float voltage setting is too high.
causes.ur: Battery 2 string zyada charge ho gayi, ya uska float voltage setting bohat zyada hai.

causes.en: Only one module in the battery 2 string is faulty, so the string voltage reads high.
causes.ur: Battery 2 string ka sirf aik module kharab hai, is liye string voltage zyada dikhti hai.

causes.en: Battery 2 string sampling or sense wire is faulty and misreads the voltage.
causes.ur: Battery 2 string ka sampling ya sense wire kharab hai aur voltage galat parh raha hai.

causes.en: Battery 1 and battery 2 packs are of different type and are not matched.
causes.ur: Battery 1 aur battery 2 ke packs alag type ke hain aur aapas mein match nahi hain.

solutions.en: Check the battery 2 terminal voltage with a multimeter and compare with the pack's own allowed window.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se battery 2 ka terminal voltage check karke pack ke apne allowed window se compare karein.

solutions.en: Compare battery 1 and battery 2 terminal voltages — a big difference points to one string or its sense wire.
solutions.ur: Battery 1 aur battery 2 ke terminal voltages compare karein — bhaara farq aik string ya uske sense wire ki taraf ishara karta hai.

solutions.en: Check the battery 2 sense/sampling wiring and connector back to the inverter with power off.
solutions.ur: Power off karke inverter tak battery 2 ki sense ya sampling wiring aur connector check karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter twice and restore the factory settings, as the manual's step 2 states.
solutions.ur: Manual ke step 2 ke mutabiq inverter do baar restart karke factory settings wapas karein.

solutions.en: If it still returns, the battery 2 string or its BMS has a faulty cell — service or replace that pack only.
solutions.ur: Phir bhi aaye to battery 2 string ya uske BMS ki koi cell kharab hai, sirf wohi pack service ya replace karein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.ur: Battery 1 ka terminal voltage zyada hai

meaning.en: The battery 1 string terminal voltage is high. Deye asks for two restarts and a factory reset. NOTE: on SG04LP3 this same number is DC busbar voltage too high.
meaning.ur: Battery 1 string ka terminal voltage zyada hai. Deye do restart aur factory reset kahein karta hai. NOTE: SG04LP3 par yehi number DC busbar voltage too high ka matlab hai.

causes.en: Battery 1 string overcharged or its float voltage setting is too high.
causes.ur: Battery 1 string zyada charge ho gayi ya uska float voltage setting bohat zyada hai.

causes.en: A faulty module in the battery 1 string makes the string voltage read high.
causes.ur: Battery 1 string ka aik module kharab hone se string voltage zyada dikhti hai.

causes.en: Battery 1 sense/sampling wire is faulty or miswired.
causes.ur: Battery 1 ka sense ya sampling wire kharab ya galat wired hai.

causes.en: Battery 1 and battery 2 packs are mismatched in type or capacity.
causes.ur: Battery 1 aur battery 2 ke packs type ya capacity mein match nahi hain.

solutions.en: Check the battery 1 terminal voltage is high with a multimeter at the inverter battery terminals.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke battery terminals par multimeter se check karein ke battery 1 ka terminal voltage zyada hai.

solutions.en: Compare battery 1 against battery 2 voltage; a mismatch isolates the string and its sense wire.
solutions.ur: Battery 1 ki voltage battery 2 se compare karein; farq us string aur uske sense wire ko isolate kar deta hai.

solutions.en: With DC off, check the battery 1 sense/sampling wiring and connector at both ends.
solutions.ur: DC off karke battery 1 ki sense ya sampling wiring aur connector dono taraf check karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter twice and restore the factory settings as the manual states.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq inverter do baar restart karke factory settings wapas karein.

solutions.en: If the code returns, the battery 1 pack or its BMS needs service — replace only that pack.
solutions.ur: Code phir bhi aaye to battery 1 pack ya uska BMS service maangta hai, sirf wohi pack badlein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.ur: Battery 1 ka terminal voltage kam hai

meaning.en: The battery 1 string terminal voltage is low. Deye's fix is two restarts and a factory reset. NOTE: on the LP lines this number is DC busbar voltage too low.
meaning.ur: Battery 1 string ka terminal voltage kam hai. Deye ka hal do restart aur factory reset hai. NOTE: LP lines par yehi number DC busbar voltage too low ka matlab hai.

causes.en: Battery 1 string is deeply discharged or has a weak cell.
causes.ur: Battery 1 string gehri tarah discharged hai ya uski koi cell kamzor hai.

causes.en: One module in the battery 1 string has a high-resistance or open connection.
causes.ur: Battery 1 string ke aik module ka connection zyada resistance wala ya khula hua hai.

causes.en: Battery 1 sense/sampling wire is loose or miswired, so the reading is wrong.
causes.ur: Battery 1 ka sense ya sampling wire loose ya galat wired hai, is liye reading ghalti hai.

causes.en: The battery 1 fuse has blown or its connector is not seated.
causes.ur: Battery 1 ka fuse udd chuka hai ya uska connector dheela baitha hua hai.

solutions.en: Check the battery 1 terminal voltage is low by measuring at the inverter with a multimeter.
solutions.ur: Inverter par multimeter se naal kar check karein ke battery 1 ka terminal voltage kam hai.

solutions.en: Measure battery 2 as well; if battery 2 is fine, the fault is isolated to the battery 1 string.
solutions.ur: Battery 2 bhi naalein; agar battery 2 theek hai to fault battery 1 string tak isolate ho gaya hai.

solutions.en: With DC off, check the battery 1 fuse, connector seating and sense/sampling wiring end to end.
solutions.ur: DC off karke battery 1 ka fuse, connector ki seating aur sense ya sampling wiring aik se aik check karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter twice and restore the factory settings, as the manual's step 2 says.
solutions.ur: Manual ke step 2 ke mutabiq inverter do baar restart karke factory settings wapas karein.

solutions.en: Voltage measured fine on a multimeter but the inverter still reports low: the sampling input is faulty — service.
solutions.ur: Multimeter par voltage theek nikle phir bhi inverter kam batae to sampling input kharab hai, service chahiye.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.ur: Battery 2 ka terminal voltage kam hai

meaning.en: The battery 2 string terminal voltage is low. This code exists only on the high-voltage dual-battery line.
meaning.ur: Battery 2 string ka terminal voltage kam hai. Ye code sirf high voltage dual battery line par mojood hai.

causes.en: Battery 2 string is deeply discharged or has a weak or failed cell.
causes.ur: Battery 2 string gehri tarah discharged hai ya uski koi cell kamzor ya fail ho gayi hai.

causes.en: Loose or high-resistance connection at a module in the battery 2 string.
causes.ur: Battery 2 string ke kisi module par loose ya zyada resistance wala connection.

causes.en: Battery 2 fuse blown or connector not seated.
causes.ur: Battery 2 ka fuse udd chuka hai ya connector dheela baitha hai.

causes.en: Battery 2 sense/sampling wire faulty, giving a false low reading.
causes.ur: Battery 2 ka sense ya sampling wire kharab hai, jis se ghalat low reading aati hai.

solutions.en: Check the battery 2 terminal voltage is low by measuring at the inverter battery terminals.
solutions.ur: Inverter ke battery terminals par naal kar check karein ke battery 2 ka terminal voltage kam hai.

solutions.en: Compare battery 1 and battery 2 voltages to confirm the fault is on the battery 2 side.
solutions.ur: Battery 1 aur battery 2 ki voltage compare karke confirm karein ke fault battery 2 taraf hai.

solutions.en: With DC off, check the battery 2 fuse, every module connection and the sense/sampling wire to the inverter.
solutions.ur: DC off karke battery 2 ka fuse, har module ka connection aur inverter tak jaane wala sense ya sampling wire check karein.

solutions.en: Restart the inverter twice and restore the factory settings, as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq inverter do baar restart karke factory settings wapas karein.

solutions.en: Real low voltage on a full charge means a failed cell in the battery 2 pack — replace that pack, not the inverter.
solutions.ur: Poori charge par bhi asal voltage kam ho to battery 2 pack ki cell fail hai, wohi pack badlein, inverter nahi.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.ur: Battery BMS ka communication lost

meaning.en: The inverter cannot talk to the battery BMS while BMS_Err-Stop is active, so it shuts down.
meaning.ur: BMS_Err-Stop active hone ke dauran inverter battery BMS se baat nahi kar pa raha, is liye band ho jata hai.

causes.en: Comms cable between the inverter and the BMS is loose or on the wrong pins.
causes.ur: Inverter aur BMS ke darmiyan comms cable loose hai ya galat pins par hai.

causes.en: BMS is asleep or stopped on its own low SOC limit.
causes.ur: BMS so raha hai ya apne low SOC limit par band ho chuka hai.

causes.en: Battery protocol setting does not match the fitted BMS.
causes.ur: Battery protocol ki setting lagay huay BMS se match nahi karti.

solutions.en: Check the comms cable seating and pinout at the inverter and at the BMS, then re-seat it.
solutions.ur: Inverter aur BMS dono taraf comms cable ki seating aur pinout check karke use dobara baithayein.

solutions.en: Confirm the BMS is powered and awake, and not latched on low voltage or low SOC.
solutions.ur: Confirm karein ke BMS power on aur jaag hua hai, aur low voltage ya low SOC par latch nahi hua.

solutions.en: Set the battery type and protocol on the LCD to the exact model fitted.
solutions.ur: LCD par battery type aur protocol woh exact model set karein jo lagaya hua hai.

solutions.en: If you do not want this stop, disable BMS_Err-Stop on the LCD — only when the pack is known good.
solutions.ur: Agar ye stop nahi chahiye to LCD se BMS_Err-Stop disable karein, magar sirf jab pack theek sabit ho.

solutions.en: Fault still present: the BMS module or its CAN transceiver needs replacement.
solutions.ur: Fault phir bhi rahe to BMS module ya uska CAN transceiver replacement maangta hai.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.ur: DRMs0_stop, demand response ne band kiya

meaning.en: The DRM port has commanded a stop. Deye states the DRM function is for the Australia market only.
meaning.ur: DRM port ne band karne ka command diya hai. Deye kehta hai ke DRM function sirf Australia market ke liye hai.

causes.en: The DRM pin is asserted by the utility or a demand response device.
causes.ur: Utility ya demand response device ne DRM pin assert kar diya hai.

causes.en: DRM wiring on the DRS port is shorted or on the wrong pin.
causes.ur: DRS port par DRM wiring short hai ya galat pin par hai.

causes.en: DRM left enabled on a non-Australian site with a live or floating DRS pin.
causes.ur: Non-Australian site par DRM chala chhuda hai aur DRS pin live ya floating hai.

solutions.en: Check whether the DRM function is active — the manual's step 2.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke DRM function active hai ya nahi, ye manual ka step 2 hai.

solutions.en: Measure the DRS pin voltage to ground with a multimeter; a live pin is what commands the stop.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se DRS pin ka ground ke qeemat voltage naalein; live pin hi stop ka command deta hai.

solutions.en: On a non-Australian site, disable DRM in the settings and disconnect the DRS wires.
solutions.ur: Non-Australian site par settings mein DRM disable karein aur DRS wires disconnect kar dein.

solutions.en: Restart the system; if it still will not return to normal, contact Deye.
solutions.ur: System restart karein; phir bhi normal par na aaye to Deye se rabta karein.

notes.en: On Pakistani sites this is practically always a mis-wired or floating DRS pin on the comms connector.
notes.ur: Pakistani sites par ye amli tor par hamesha DRS pin ki galat wiring ya floating pin hoti hai.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.ur: ARC fault, PV mein arc detect hua

meaning.en: The PV arc fault detector has tripped. Deye notes ARC detection is only for the US market.
meaning.ur: PV arc fault detector trigger ho gaya hai. Deye kehta hai ke ARC detection sirf US market ke liye hai.

causes.en: DC connector not fully seated and arcing under load.
causes.ur: DC connector poora fit nahi hai aur load ke neeche arc kar raha hai.

causes.en: Burnt or badly crimped DC plug.
causes.ur: Jala hua ya kharab crimp wala DC plug.

causes.en: PV cable insulation damaged by UV, heat or rodents.
causes.ur: UV, garmi ya chuhe se PV cable ki insulation kharab.

solutions.en: Check the PV module cable connection and clear the fault at the cable side first.
solutions.ur: Pehle PV module cable ka connection check karke us taraf ka fault theek karein.

solutions.en: Open the DC switch, confirm dead, then inspect every MC4 pair by hand for full insertion.
solutions.ur: DC switch khol ke dead confirm karein, phir har MC4 pair ki poori seating haath se check karein.

solutions.en: Replace loose, heat-damaged or wrongly crimped connectors.
solutions.ur: Loose, garmi se kharab ya galat crimp wale connectors replace karein.

solutions.en: If the cable fault is cleared and F63 stays, seek Deye help as the manual says.
solutions.ur: Cable fault theek hone ke baad bhi F63 rahe to manual ke mutabiq Deye se madad lein.

source.title: Deye Hybrid Inverter SUN-5K-25K-SG01HP3-EU-AM2 User Manual (instructions_sun-5-25k-sg01hp3-eu-am2_240203_en)

title.ur: Heatsink temperature bohat zyada ho gayi

meaning.en: The heat sink temperature is above the trip level, so the inverter shuts down. Deye says turn it off for 10 minutes then restart.
meaning.ur: Heat sink temperature trip level se upar hai, is liye inverter band ho jata hai. Deye kehta hai ke 10 minute band rakhein phir restart karein.

causes.en: The working environment temperature is too high for the installation.
causes.ur: Installation ke liye working environment temperature bohat zyada hai.

causes.en: Fan is broken or its cable is not connected.
causes.ur: Fan toota hua hai ya uska cable connected nahi hai.

causes.en: Heat sink is blocked with dust or the unit has no airflow around it.
causes.ur: Heat sink dhool se band hai ya unit ke aas paas hawa nahi aati.

solutions.en: Check whether the working environment temperature is too high, measured at the unit.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke working environment temperature zyada to nahi, unit par hi naalein.

solutions.en: Turn off the inverter for 10 minutes and restart it, as the manual instructs.
solutions.ur: Manual ke mutabiq inverter ko 10 minute ke liye band karke restart karein.

solutions.en: With the unit off, check the fan connector and that the fan spins freely, then clean the fins.
solutions.ur: Unit off karke fan connector check karein aur fan ka azaad chalna dekhein, phir fins saaf karein.

solutions.en: Still tripping in a cool ventilated space: the NTC temperature sensor is faulty.
solutions.ur: Thande aur hawa wale kamre mein bhi aaye to NTC temperature sensor kharab hai.
